newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom boosts first half profit 56 pct.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom boosts first half profit 56 pct.

text.p: State-controlled telecommunications company Portugal Telecom said on Thursday that its profits jumped 56 percent over the first half of 1996 to 23 billion escudos ($148 million), compared with the same period last year.
Total operating revenues were up 10 percent at 229.98 billion escudos.
The results were in line with analysts' forecasts which had ranged from a low of 20 billion escudos up to 26 billion.
But the figures were better than the company, 49 percent of which has been privatised, had been predicting two months ago when it said it saw first half profit at around 21 billion.
It gave no forecast for the full-year result, although it said that "expectations remain strong, taking into account the increasing competition which now characterises our business."
